# TC-CLI-313 进度事件（契约 §3.1）：备份先 scan（不带总量）后 pack（带总量，等于 scan 结果），
# 还原只有 restore（总量取自容器尾部）；阶段结束时的一次进度等于最终值；最后一行是 result。

exec databackup --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/repo --name p
stdout '^\{"type":"progress","phase":"scan","files":3,"bytes":12,"current":"[^"]+"\}$'
stdout '^\{"type":"progress","phase":"pack","files":3,"bytes":12,"totalFiles":3,"totalBytes":12,"current":"[^"]+"\}$'
! stdout '"phase":"scan"[^}]*"totalFiles"'
stdout '^\{"type":"result","command":"backup",.*"files":3,"dirs":1,"bytes":12,'

exec databackup --json restore --backup p --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/out
stdout '^\{"type":"progress","phase":"restore","files":3,"bytes":12,"totalFiles":3,"totalBytes":12,"current":"[^"]+"\}$'
! stdout '"phase":"(scan|pack)"'
stdout '^\{"type":"result","command":"restore",.*"files":3,"dirs":1,"bytes":12,'

# dry-run 只有 scan
exec databackup --json backup --source $WORK/src --dry-run
stdout '"phase":"scan","files":3,"bytes":12'
! stdout '"phase":"pack"'

-- src/a.txt --
hello
-- src/d/b.txt --
world
-- src/d/empty --
